{{SupportPage|vendor=NETGEAR|model=WG311T}} This device is a [[Ambit Microsystems T60H677]] on a Mini-PCI to PCI adapter. A metal shield covers the Mini PCI module. The PCI ID on this device is presumed to be 168c:0013. "U12H009.00" is silkscreened on the PCI card.
